name: gas_emissions_factor
note: OPG 2021 ESG report, footnote: CO2 emissions intensity estimates calculated assuming emissions of 450 gCO2e/kWh for gas. Range: efficient combined-cycle plants (~0.40) to peaker plants (~0.55); UNECE life-cycle assessment gives 0.403-0.513 for combined-cycle gas: https://unece.org/sites/default/files/2021-11/LCA_final.pdf
